comparison.objective: Cut marked copper tubing without denting or spiraling the cut; candidate instead sets and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeatedly feed and orbit a tubing cutter with handoffs; no jam-nut counterholding that preserves an angular setting.
comparison.success_condition: Requires controlled groove depth, completed cut, roundness, mark accuracy, and release; candidate requires retained 90° opening across three cycles.
comparison.reason: Both use tools and rotational control, but the tested mechanisms and outcomes—progressive cutting versus lock-preserved stop adjustment—are meaningfully different.
